source_review: durable_execution.reserve_outbound converts only HTTP429 carrying OUTBOUND_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED or CAMPAIGN_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED to the existing typed budget exception. Other HTTP status, malformed JSON, non-object bodies or unrelated codes preserve the actual original exception. Actor, opaque operation registration, reserve payload, endpoint and authentication are unchanged.

call_budget.CallBudgetExceeded now carries existing BizException429 status/code while preserving RuntimeError compatibility. Existing ledger writes, caps, campaign selection and reservation accounting are unchanged; rejected calls do not reset or bypass the ledger.

amap_mcp_client.call preserves the exact budget exception from the invoked operation before generic MCP-error wrapping. amap_mcp_service distinguishes ordinary upstream detail errors from malformed/missing coordinates without swallowing typed budget exhaustion.

data_nodes rethrows CallBudgetExceeded before existing optional-data fallbacks at attraction discovery, knowledge augmentation, specific lookups, weather, accommodation and food collection. It does not turn exhaustion into an empty candidate success or continue towards broad/model work.

Five direct tests verify actual invoked client cancellation/no tool send on rejection, central429 code and zero local accounting, existing HTTP429/error SSE contracts without a result, preserved ordinary detail behavior, and real graph propagation before model lookup. Source-level review does not claim these fixtures are new live-provider results.

All eleven Java GET entry points, four concrete flow objects each, fixed status-path early returns, Operation receiver identity, authenticated actor and cookie/header CSRF boundary remain exact from881. Python endpoint definitions, HTTP methods and allowed actors did not change; the new failure propagation does not expose a trip/account/permission mutation through GET.
provider_boundary: User explicitly authorized subsequent offline validation after the real budget was exhausted. The failed real attempt and ledger remain unchanged; no model/Amap call or successful live acceptance is newly claimed.
